newsitem.title: EGYPT: Privatised Egyptian pesticide firm has new board.
newsitem.headline: Privatised Egyptian pesticide firm has new board.

text.p: Shareholders of Kafr el-Zayat Pesticides and Chemicals, at their first meeting since the state privatised 65 percent of the firm in August, elected former managing director Abdelfattah Abu Zeid as chairman and managing director, company officials said on Sunday.
The new deputy chairman is Abdelsalam Ahmed el-Madbouli, who was the company's production manager, and the state holding company is represented on the board by Said Gumai, they added.

New private-sector directors are Esmat el-Sayyad of Egyptian Financial and Industrial, Mohamed Maher Mohamed Ali of the SAIB fund, Mesham Heikal of Commercial International Bank and George el-Daba, one of the company's biggest customers, they said.
The sale through the stock exchange was one of the state's most successful privatisations. Company workers have taken 10 percent of the equity, leaving about 25 percent in state hands.
